record.NAME: k_cta_ego_abs_speed_max
record.DESCRIPTION: CTA will only work for absolute ego speed values equal or below this value.

record.NAME: k_cta_stop_alert_ttc
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum TTC to stop a triggered alert early.

record.NAME: k_cta_stop_alert_ttp
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum TTP to stop a triggered alert early.

record.NAME: k_cta_min_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum speed for a target to be considered.

record.NAME: k_cta_min_park_angle
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum parking angle for host.

record.NAME: k_cta_butterfly_long
record.DESCRIPTION: The longitudinal coordinates of butterfly zone points. Total amount is restricted by k_cta_amount_butterfly_points_in_use

record.NAME: k_cta_butterfly_lat
record.DESCRIPTION: The lateral coordinates of butterfly zone points. Total amount is restricted by k_cta_amount_butterfly_points_in_use

record.NAME: k_cta_amount_butterfly_points_in_use
record.DESCRIPTION: Actual amount of points which are in use for the definition of butterfly zone. Must be less than maximum allowed butterfly points

record.NAME: k_cta_ttc_criticality_level
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum Offset of the target's TTC for the first warning level. First dimension = RCTA, Second dimension = FCTA

record.NAME: k_cta_speed_criticality_level
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum target speed for the first and second warning level. First dimension = RCTA, Second dimension = FCTA

record.NAME: k_cta_max_long_point_criticality_level
record.DESCRIPTION: Upper border of field of interest located on the longitudinal axis in vcs. For RCTA the reference is on the rear bumper and for FCTA on the front bumper. First dimension = RCTA, Second dimension = FCTA.

record.NAME: k_cta_min_long_point_criticality_level
record.DESCRIPTION: Lower border of field of interest located on the longitudinal axis in vcs. For RCTA the reference is on the rear bumper and for FCTA on the front bumper. First dimension = RCTA, Second dimension = FCTA.

record.NAME: k_cta_enable_modes
record.DESCRIPTION: This calibration enables either rear or front CTA. First dimension = RCTA, Second dimension = FCTA.

record.NAME: k_cta_min_lateral_approach_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum lateral speed of targets to be considered.

record.NAME: k_cta_cycle_count_suppress_true_warning
record.DESCRIPTION: Qualifier for the number of cycles required for each critical level.

record.NAME: k_cta_cycle_count_hold_true_warning
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum number of cycles requiered to hold each criticality level.

record.NAME: k_cta_min_rel_existence_probability
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum existence probability of object.

record.NAME: k_cta_rel_warning_hysteresis
record.DESCRIPTION: Relative offset for the hysteresis of all relevant parameters for each criticality level (in percent).

record.NAME: k_cta_f_adapt_intersect_lines_by_steering_angle
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to turn on or off steering-angle-based adaptation of the intersect lines associated with the criticality levels.

record.NAME: k_cta_fcta_steer_angle_table
record.DESCRIPTION: Angle table of characteristic curve for steering-angle-based adaptation of the conflict zone.

record.NAME: k_cta_fcta_steer_factor_table
record.DESCRIPTION: Factor table of characteristic curve for steering-angle-based adaptation of the conflict zone.

record.NAME: k_cta_rcta_steer_angle_table
record.DESCRIPTION: Angle table of characteristic curve for steering-angle-based adaptation of the conflict zone.

record.NAME: k_cta_rcta_steer_factor_table
record.DESCRIPTION: Factor table of characteristic curve for steering-angle-based adaptation of the conflict zone.

record.NAME: k_cta_rcta_host_speed_factor
record.DESCRIPTION: Factor for host speed-based adaptation of adaptation of the intersect lines associated with the criticality levels.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_adapt_intersect_lines_by_obj_heading
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to turn on or off object-heading-based adaptation of the intersect lines associated with the criticality levels.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_adapt_intersect_lines_by_host_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to turn on or off host-speed-based adaptation of the intersect lines associated with the criticality levels.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_prevent_fall_back_to_critlevel_1
record.DESCRIPTION: Set to 0: Criticality level may drop to level 1 once it has been higher than 1; set to 1: criticality level will remain higher than 1 once it has been higher than 1 even though the conditions for the higher level are not met any longer.

record.NAME: k_cta_max_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum speed of object to be a valid candidate for CTA.

record.NAME: k_cta_max_length_fov
record.DESCRIPTION: One of the parameter defining field of interest. This parameter defines maximum length of that area in polar coordinate system attached to the radar position.

record.NAME: k_cta_heading_range
record.DESCRIPTION: Parameter describing the permissible heading range of objects to be valid.

record.NAME: k_cta_angles_zone_definition
record.DESCRIPTION: Angles which can be used for definition of field of interest. Parameter 0 defines top border of that area measured from the horizontal line covering radar position up toward the x axis. 1 defines bottom border of that area measured from the horizontal line covering radar position down toward the x axis

record.NAME: k_cta_f_apply_heading_compensation_on_intersection_point
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to turn on or off the adaption of calculated intersection point by a value depending on target heading and ego width.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_calc_ttc_ego_side_enabled
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to turn on or off calculate TTC with reference to the ego side instead of x-axis defined in VCS.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_calc_ttp_ego_side_enabled
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to turn on or off calculate TTP with reference to the ego side instead of x-axis defined in VCS.

record.NAME: k_cta_min_object_age_check_valid
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal age of an object in cycles to be considered by the algorithm.

record.NAME: k_cta_min_object_age_thres
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal age of an object in cycles used for criticality level calculation.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_use_heading_for_relative_velocity_calculation
record.DESCRIPTION: If flag is set to true, the relative velocity vector of an object will be calculated by making use of heading and absolute velocity of an object. If it is set to false, the relative velocity provided by the tracker will be used.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_apply_path_tracking
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to turn on or off path tracking algorithm.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_discard_pt_heading_when_moving
record.DESCRIPTION: Switch to turn on or off path tracking when moving backwards when additional conditions are fulfilled (min_host_speed_to_discard_pt_info, obj_dist_to_discard_pt_info).

record.NAME: k_cta_min_host_speed_to_discard_pt_info
record.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for the host speed so that path tracking information usage is disabled.

record.NAME: k_cta_obj_dist_to_discard_pt_info
record.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for the distance between host and target so that path tracking information usage is disabled.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_check_reflection_signal
record.DESCRIPTION: If flag is set to true, objects with a f_reflection signal set to true will be considered in criticality level calculation.

record.NAME: k_cta_cycles_coasted_to_ignore
record.DESCRIPTION: Defines the cycles that an object can maximal be coasted to be still considered by the algo.

record.NAME: k_cta_ghost_condition_max_heading_diff_path_tracker
record.DESCRIPTION: This defines the maximum difference between the heading provided by the path algo and the tracker that is accaptable.

record.NAME: k_cta_max_obstruction_probability
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum obstruction probability of the object when object is considered as valid.

record.NAME: k_cta_object_supress_counter
record.DESCRIPTION: This counter supresses objects that are untrusted for a number of cycles.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_use_object_supress_counter
record.DESCRIPTION: This flag indicates whether the object_supress_counter shall be used.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_use_ghost_detector
record.DESCRIPTION: This flags activates the check whether the object is a ghost within the object validation.

record.NAME: k_cta_ghost_validation_min_age
record.DESCRIPTION: Min age of a potential ghost to be considerd by the object validation.

record.NAME: k_cta_ghost_validation_min_mature
record.DESCRIPTION: Min mature age of a potential ghost to be considerd by the object validation.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_check_obstruction_probability_signal
record.DESCRIPTION: if flag is set true, obstruction probability of the object is considered for the validity check

record.NAME: k_cta_min_mature_cycles_level_qualifiction
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum required number of consecutive cycles for an object status to be mature for activation of a criticality level.

record.NAME: k_cta_min_ttc_additional_mature_qualification
record.DESCRIPTION: Above this parameter additional maturity cycles are required to trigger warning level.

record.NAME: k_cta_additional_qualification_mature_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Additional maturity cycles for an object to qualify for a warning level.

record.NAME: k_cta_max_object_eclipse_for_level_qualification
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum eclipse value of a target to qualify for setting a warn level.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_use_object_min_object_age_in_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag indicating whether object age threshold is used to check cta relevance for this object.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_use_rel_vel_isect_point_calc
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag indicating whether to use relative velocity or heading of tracker to calculate intersection point.

record.NAME: k_cta_intersection_line_host_width_percentage
record.DESCRIPTION: The lateral position of the longitudinal intersection point is set as a percentage of the vehicle half vehicle width. (0.0 = host mid, 1.0 = host side).

record.NAME: k_ctb_lower_safety_distance_thres
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the minimum distance at which the ego must remain in relation to the target's driving tube.

record.NAME: k_ctb_upper_safety_distance_thres_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the maximum distance at which the ego must remain in relation to the target's driving tube. This upper threshold is used for blocked scenarios. It is adapted dependent on the host vehicle velocity.

record.NAME: k_ctb_safety_dist_host_vel_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Depicts the host velocity dimension for an adaption of the upper safety distance threshold within CTB.

record.NAME: k_ctb_event_time_buffer
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the buffer used additionally to the overall event time, so that no exact brake is needed.

record.NAME: k_ctb_min_braking_time
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the lower threshold value of TTC Interval for brake request.

record.NAME: k_ctb_max_braking_time
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the maximal threshold value of TTC Interval for brake request.

record.NAME: k_ctb_responsetime_brake_actuation
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the time between output of brake request and activation of brake.

record.NAME: k_ctb_ramp_in_time
record.DESCRIPTION: This describes the time before the maximum deceleration of the ramp for actuation of the brake in the event of emergency braking is reached.

record.NAME: k_ctb_const_decel_after_ramp_in
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the final value of deceleration reached after the braking process. Describes an absolute value.

record.NAME: k_ctb_braking_jerk
record.DESCRIPTION: This describes the jerk of the ramp used for emergency braking. Describes an absolute value.

record.NAME: k_ctb_host_acc_weight
record.DESCRIPTION: This weight factor controls the influence of the acceleration value on the predicted velocity in each prediction step.

record.NAME: k_ctb_min_brake_qual_ctr_thres
record.DESCRIPTION: Qualification counter threshold for braking logic.

record.NAME: k_ctb_min_brake_hold_ctr_thres
record.DESCRIPTION: Holds the brake qualifier on each side for at least this specified amount of cycles.

record.NAME: k_ctb_time_to_ask_for_final_brake_decel
record.DESCRIPTION: Time when the final brake deceleration shall be requested so that deceleration is increased incrementally.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_enable_thres_crit_level_reset
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag indicating whether to reset the criticality level when an object passes a user defined threshold.

record.NAME: k_cta_dist_thres_crit_level_reset
record.DESCRIPTION: Indicates at which lateral distance the criticality level is reset. Distance is calculated as the % of vehicle width. Requires k_cta_f_enable_thres_crit_level_reset to be true.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_use_front_corners_dist_stop
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag indicating to use front corners of an object to check, whether it has already passed a user defined longitudinal axis so that alert can be turned off. Default are rear corners.

record.NAME: k_cta_DEBUG_MODE
record.DESCRIPTION: If this param is used, f_cta_radar_position and f_cta_switch are set by cal_params.

record.NAME: k_cta_enable_ctb
record.DESCRIPTION: This flag enables CTB if set to TRUE and disables it if set to FALSE.

record.NAME: k_cta_switch
record.DESCRIPTION: If this param is used, f_cta_switch is set to true, else false.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_brake_overriding_ctb
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag used to enable CTB overriding.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_use_brake_gradient
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag used to enable the usage of the k_cta_braking_gradient instead of calculating it from k_cta_target_acceleration_target_braking and k_cta_target_acceleration_target_braking_time.

record.NAME: k_cta_accelerationpedal_gradient_threshold_ctb
record.DESCRIPTION: Threshold value to evaluate when CTB overriding shall be activated.

record.NAME: k_cta_addit_mature_cycles_outside_sensor_fov
record.DESCRIPTION: Additional suppression cycles which are applied in case that objects are moving outside a given field of view threshold.

record.NAME: k_cta_host_width_sensor_fov_suppr_factor
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables user to shift the lateral component of origin for sensor FOV suppression cycle calculation.

record.NAME: k_cta_sensor_fov_border
record.DESCRIPTION: With respect to sensor borders defined in this cal additional suppression cycles can be applied. First dimension = RCTA, Second dimension = FCTA

record.NAME: k_cta_min_age_obj_outside_sensor_fov
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum age for objects which are declared outside of the sensor field of view.

record.NAME: k_cta_max_heading_variance
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum heading variance for valid objects.

record.NAME: k_cta_min_qual_age_obj_crossing_paths
record.DESCRIPTION: age of the object which is necessary to qualify in case of a lane change, when it is crossing its nearest path

record.NAME: k_cta_max_seg_heading_diff_no_ghost
record.DESCRIPTION: heading diff threshold for the path segment where object is currently located in of the nearest located path so that object is not qualified as ghost

record.NAME: k_cta_range_to_path_segment_ghost_qualif
record.DESCRIPTION: range to the path segment where object is located so that it can be qualified as ghost

record.NAME: k_cta_cycles_valid_match_of_pot_ghost
record.DESCRIPTION: Cycles for an object to be matched to a path with a minimum confidence so that it is not classified as potential ghost anymore

record.NAME: k_cta_age_for_new_creation_below_long_intersection
record.DESCRIPTION: When an object is newly created directly in the longitudinal area between host width and longitudinal intersection, it shall be suppressed.

record.NAME: k_cta_ttc_warntrigger_early
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum Offset of the target's TTC if if k_cta_warntrigger_hmi=2.

record.NAME: k_cta_ttc_warntrigger_late
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum Offset of the target's TTC if k_cta_warntrigger_hmi=0.

record.NAME: k_cta_f_enable_heading_exp_moving_average
record.DESCRIPTION: Indicates if the exponential moving average function for the object heading is enabled.

record.NAME: k_cta_object_heading_exp_moving_average_alpha
record.DESCRIPTION: Set alpha value for exponential moving average filter for object heading. Higher alpha means more weight for current values.

record.NAME: k_cta_pedestrian_min_size
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum size for an object classified as pedestrian to be selected as a valid candidate for CTA when other criteria are met

record.NAME: k_cta_pedestrian_min_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum speed for an object classified as pedestrian to be selected as a valid candidate for CTA when other criteria are met

record.NAME: k_cta_2wheel_min_size
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum size for an object classified as 2wheel to be selected as a valid candidate for CTA when other criteria are met

record.NAME: k_cta_2wheel_min_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum speed for an object classified as 2wheel to be selected as a valid candidate for CTA when other criteria are met

record.NAME: k_cta_f_stop_mode_ttp
record.DESCRIPTION: Summarizes the alert stop modes for CTA. If flag is enabled we use TTP threshold for alert suppresion, otherwise we use TTC

record.NAME: k_cta_min_deceleration_value
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum deceleration value for braking

record.NAME: k_cta_max_deceleration_value
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum deceleration value for braking

record.NAME: k_cta_ttc_calc_positive_ref_point
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum deceleration value for braking

record.NAME: k_cta_speed_thresh_for_rel_vel_calc
record.DESCRIPTION: Below this threshold object relative velocity will be calculated by using its heading
